confirmation_gate.support_condition: On the six untouched confirmation rolls, the fixed dual readout must exceed the strongest reference macro Pixel AP by at least 0.001, remain within 0.002 all-instance AUC of the strongest reference, beat the best reference on at least four rolls, and reproduce every PCAF parent score and operating-point metric exactly. All six rolls are reported.
confirmation_gate.strong_pareto_condition: In addition to exact PCAF parent alarming, confirmation macro Pixel AP and all-instance AUC must both exceed the corresponding strongest reference values.
